## What are you contributing?

Briefly describe the record, method, correction, or provenance improvement.

## Source and permission check

- [ ] I used the provenance-card template or explained why it does not apply.
- [ ] I identified the source distance accurately.
- [ ] I am authorized to share the submitted material.
- [ ] I excluded hidden thinking/reasoning, credentials, secrets, and unnecessary personal information.
- [ ] I selected an artifact permission.
- [ ] I recorded known dissent, corrections, or unresolved consent questions.

## Claim boundary

What does this contribution support, and what does it not establish?

## Maintainer note

Formatting help is welcome. Please do not strengthen the contributor's claims or smooth away recorded disagreement.
